lines: A new group of enemy soldiers was coming towards us just as we had taken up positions to fight within the building.
And they weren't your average thugs.
Well-trained guards and experienced mercenaries took up formation and assaulted us together as a team.
The narrow corridor resounded with the continuous sound of gunfire as they pressed their attack.
Slipping past the rain of bullets from which there was no escape, perhaps even taking some of the shots willingly, Sonia unleashed her true homicidal maniac nature.
With each swing of her bloodstained iron claws, Sonia's own blood and several times as much of her enemies stained the corridor in their crimson color.
Aahhn! Hurt me more! I'll make sure to pay you back plenty!
Don't get too far ahead, nee-chan!!
A well-aimed sniper shot from the Orc dude had pierced the cranium of a woman who appeared to be the enemy commander.
Yeah! You've gotten pretty good too, kid. You're like a whole different person!
I cut down one of the enemies who had fallen into a state of panic as I replied to Orc dude.
Demonstrating the demonic powers that I'd recently been able to awaken to slightly,
I managed to move just enough to not be a burden and neatly finished off the last two stragglers.
Ah-haan! It was the right call to hole up here. I can't wait to see all of my prey come squirming out!
And if they don't then it'd probably mean trouble for us.
Gwahahahaha! You're not wrong! Now we just hafta wait for that steely nee-chan to do her thing!
Mutsuho sharply thrust forward with her poison needle.
Ahahaha! You think that'll do any good for you now?!
Muscle Joe didn't even try to dodge it.
Far from it, he greatly puffed up his chest and caught the poison needle right above his heart.
The clear sound of the needle snapping could be heard as it collided with his metal body without even scratching its surface.
However, Mutsuho seemed to have expected that, and took one more step in.
Spreading out both palms before her, a murky rotting poison exuded from them as she pressed them against his shining silver chest.
It was a deadly poison that could cause even inhabitants of the Devildom to rot to death.
Oh my, what's this? Are you trying to measure my heartbeat? Sorry, but that's not enough to make me skip a beat.
Now let me give you a gift in return, from my own two hands.
Muscle Joe had gripped both of Mutsuho's shoulders softly, almost lovingly,
then let loose the electricity charged in his steel muscles.
Raising a high-pitched scream, Mutsuho's body bounced and twitched as the electricity ran through her.
Oh my. That's quite a cute voice.
He cheerfully released Mutsuho, allowing her to fall to the floor.
Imprints of his palms were burned into her shoulders as smoke rose from them.
Well? What do you think of the electricity stored in these metal muscles!?
I could scorch you the whole way through, but I still have to impregnate you.
As Mutsuho endured the pain of the electric shock, she desperately tried to make a hand sign.
Oh dear, is this one of those special Taimanin Ninja Arts this time?
Very well. Try all you like until you realize how completely impotent your poison is. Hah!
Muscle Joe once again struck a pose not unlike those he had struck during their fight before, showing off every muscle in his body.
Ghngh... N-, Ninja Art: Poison Death Blossom!
A mist of purple poison welled up from Mutsuho's entire body.
Seemingly having a mind of its own, this poison mist then made to attack Muscle Joe.
Hahahahahahaha!! So you still don't understand that it doesn't work against my flawlessly healthy body!?
Muscle Joe simply put his hands on his hips and roared with laughter.
Even when enveloped in the deadly mist, he looked completely unconcerned.
He even stuck out his silver chest once more and began inhaling the poisonous mist using his monstrous lung capacity.
The lethal poison mist was sucked into Muscle Joe's mouth before her eyes.
Muscle Joe puckered his face for the first time, then spat out a lump of chewed-up poison mist as sticky phlegm.
Mutsuho at last fallen to her knees in defeat.
No way... There's no way... my poison... won't work on him... My... My poison... My poison...
Mutsuho's eyes were completely vacant as she murmured her protests, and she seemed to be on the verge of losing her mind.
Oh dear, was your spirit the first to break?
Well, I can't exactly blame you for despairing at the sight of my flawlessly healthy body.
Mutsuho was still muttering something unintelligible while staring off in another direction.
Well this spoils all the fun. Seems the likes of you Taimanin are no match for me.
Shrugging his shoulders, Muscle Joe moved in to seize the hysterical Mutsuho.
But Mutsuho lifted her head at the last moment and took a large leap back.
And then she quickly weaved another hand sign.
Oh? Have you come to your senses?
A clear toxic miasma emerged from Mutsuho's mouth just as she finished speaking those words.
However, compared to the purple poisonous fog from earlier, this haze was far more faint.
Another new poison? You never learn, do you?
Mutsuho showered the exasperated Muscle Joe with the colorless, transparent toxic breath.
And without a hint of hesitation, Muscle Joe had again inhaled every last bit of poison...
*Chew chew chew* It's even worse than before. ーPlegh!!
...then chewed it up and spit it back out.
Shedding her optical camouflage, Asuka had suddenly appeared in the room.
Simultaneously firing off a missile straight at Muscle Joe.
Fool!!! Even missiles can't harm this perfectly flawless body!!!
Muscle Joe didn't even try to avoid it; he put his hands on his hips to catch the missile head-on.
Oh, by the way, that poison of Mutsuho's you just chewed up?
That's acrylonitrile. It's a deadly poison. And highly flammable.
The missile then rammed directly into Muscle Joe's gut.
His steely flesh burst into flames with the explosion.
And as the flames drew close to his mouth where the acrylonitrile remained...
...Muscle Joe's head was blown off with a sound much like that of a popping cork of a champagne bottle.
Looks like even his prized muscles couldn't handle the pressure huh?
The headless body lurched forward, then fell with a heavy thud.
His supposedly flawless body that he'd received from a devil had exploded from the inside out and now lay smouldering on the ground.
Mutsuho meanwhile continued to stare at this sight in utter disbelief.
That's right. You have some powerful Ninja Arts. That's what Fuma told me.
He said that if you could properly utilize the properties of the "poisons" produced in your body, it would be a great Ninja Art.
Mutsuho's seemingly crazed murmuring earlier had actually been her talking to Asuka, who had been invisible.
Asuka had told Mutsuho about the plan from Fuma, and although only half-convinced, she'd gone along with it and successfully assassinated Muscle Joe in spectacular fashion.
Morning had come to Tokyo Kingdom.
We emerged from the now deserted building that had been the Muscle Gang's base.
With their boss Muscle Joe defeated, the remaining gang members and hired mercenaries had scattered and fled.
Ahhh, that was fun. I feel so refreshed after racking up all those kills.
Sonia's voice was particularly lively after all was said and done.

She was even more of a bloody horrifying sight than the rest of us, but what creeped us out was more the fact that there was just as much of her own blood mixed in from her actively seeking out and enjoying the pain.
Don't tell me you want to have it out with me now...
Tee-hee, I won't. I want us to kill each other in a more beautiful way, don't you?
Even if she asked me that, that wasn't exactly the issue I had with it...
Let's dress up and have some fun with just the two of us next time. Buh-bye♪
And with that, Sonia walked away, smiling happily as if she had just had a successful date.
I was relieved for now, but having promised another date (with death) had left me with an unpleasant feeling deep in my gut.
Gwahahahaha!! Some crazy gals have really taken a liking to ya, huh kid!
Orc dude was guffawing with laughter after putting in some impressive work again today as well.
Mind taking my place for me, Orc dude? Seems like you're pretty well-liked, too.
Sorry, I'll hafta pass on that one!! Alrighty, I'll be taking my leave here too. Give Sakura my best. Oh and make sure to transfer the reward to my account.
With the air of a mercenary who had just finished his job, Orc dude walked off briskly into the crowd.
Kay, time for me to go home, too. I wanna take a shower, plus I'm beat from staying up all night. Hnnnnnngh...!!
Asuka squinted her eyes at the brightly shining morning sun, then gave a big stretch with her android limbs.
At some point she had changed back into her uniform without any of us noticing.
Alright Fuma. Mutsuho. Let's meet again someday if anything comes up.
I'd rather not, thank you. Nothing good ever happens when I meet you anyway.
Asuka stuck out her tongue in a playful display, then literally disappeared on the spot with her optical camouflage.
The only ones left were Mutsuho and myself.
Her words no longer contained the harsh sting that they had before.
Whether it's Sonia or Asuka, they're not really people I want to be friends with. Orc dude's different though.
Okay, we should go too then. I've called for our extraction team, so let's meet up with them first.
What's up, Mutsuho? Those injuries hurting you?
I looked into Mutsuho's face with her head hung low, and she looked up as if startled.
It's fine. I can reverse the poison's effects to help boost my recovery.
That's good then, but don't overdo it.
When I started walking, Mutsuho followed after me.
I'm sorry I went off on my own like that.
I could hear her listless voice from behind me.
We finished the mission without any trouble, so it's all good.
A brief moment after I'd said that, Mutsuho had quickly marched around to my front.
I was surprised that you came to save me, but I'm so glad you did.
She'd given a shockingly honest and straightforward expression of gratitude.
Even I was a little embarrassed by it.
Asuka was the one who saved you though, not me.
But thanks to you, I discovered new possibilities for myself.
I, I see. That's great to hear.
Well, that means you can fight without having to sacrifice yourself. Not like a "Diot" like me, huh.
Heh. It's strange. You're a ninja, and yet you'd show such kindness for a kunoichi and her fate.
And in my eyes, that smile looked even more dazzling than the morning sun...
